cards.public_summary: The Browns placed Dillon Gabriel on injured reserve as they set their initial 53-man roster.
cards.evidence: Offensively, the Browns are rostering three quarterbacks in Taylen Green, Shedeur Sanders and Deshaun Watson, with Sanders to serve as the backup quarterback to Watson as the starter. The Browns also placed Dillon Gabriel on injured reserve.
cards.commentary: Gabriel is off Cleveland's active roster for now, removing any immediate path to game action. The report does not identify the injury or provide a return timeline.
cards.author: Kelsey Russo

cards.public_summary: Shedeur Sanders will back up Browns starter Deshaun Watson after Cleveland set its initial 53-man roster.
cards.evidence: Offensively, the Browns are rostering three quarterbacks in Taylen Green, Shedeur Sanders and Deshaun Watson, with Sanders to serve as the backup quarterback to Watson as the starter. The Browns also placed Dillon Gabriel on injured reserve.
cards.commentary: Sanders is officially positioned as Watson’s backup, giving him contingency value only if Watson misses time. Monitor whether Cleveland changes the quarterback depth chart or Watson’s availability.
